title: Making Systems conference program
audience: Design and engineering practitioners deciding whether to attend a one-day conference
scenario: Making Systems is a small in-person conference in Toronto focused on the collaboration behind durable digital products.
task: Build an event page that balances identity and practical program information, leading visitors toward a clearly described ticket action.

sections: Navigation with Program, Speakers, Venue, Access, and Get tickets
Hero with October 17, 2026, Toronto, the primary heading, and Get tickets
Speakers Lena Park, Omar El-Sayed, Jo Rivera, and Nikhil Bose with roles and session titles
Venue details for Junction Hall, 88 Sterling Road, Toronto
Access information covering step-free entry, live captions, quiet room, and dietary needs contact
Ticket note: General admission $240 CAD; ticket checkout is not implemented

requirements: Associate each session with time, title, speaker, and format
Use time elements or equivalent machine-readable program times
Make venue and accessibility information easy to find before the footer
State the ticket price, currency, and static checkout limitation together
Provide a linear and readable program at narrow widths
constraints: Do not implement ticket purchase, maps, calendar export, or filters
Do not invent sponsors, speaker biographies, or venue amenities
Do not use remote headshots, maps, fonts, or scripts
Do not hide practical details behind hover or interaction
evaluation_focus: Balance of expressive event identity and practical decision information
